description:
1. Capture the current value of var and save its literal representation and origin context to a file named 'var_snapshot.txt'.  
2. Inspect the captured representation to determine and record the runtime type name and any numeric-type indicators into 'var_type.txt'.  
3. Attempt to parse or convert the captured value into an integer, recording the parsed integer, any conversion errors, and any fractional remainder into 'parse_result.txt'.  
4. Consolidate 'var_type.txt' and 'parse_result.txt' into a single summary file 'decision_ready.txt' that lists the checks performed and whether they all passed, preparing the information needed to decide the final "yes" or "no" answer without producing that answer.

Test if variable var is an integer? If so, tell me "yes", otherwise tell me "no". (Without quotes)
